name: jobspipe
title: JobsPipe
description: The JobsPipe MCP server lets AI agents search live, normalized job postings from 30+ sources, list job sources and pricing plans, and search Upwork postings through tool-style actions. This public server needs no key; live results come from the authenticated server or the REST API.

authentication.description: No authentication. search_jobs returns real live postings, capped at 3 rows a call and limited to the common filters; every response carries the total match count and the authenticated REST call that returns the full set.

tools.name: search_jobs
tools.description: Search live, normalized job postings across 30+ sources by title, skill/tech, country, remote, seniority, employment type and recency. Returns real matching postings -- title, company, domain, location, salary range, tech stack and apply URL -- capped at 3 rows per call on this no-key server, with the total match count and the REST call that returns the rest.

tools.name: list_job_sources
tools.description: List the ATS and job-board sources JobsPipe normalizes into a single JSON schema, with coverage and freshness notes.

tools.name: list_pricing_plans
tools.description: List JobsPipe pricing plans with monthly price in USD (and the yearly price, two months free), monthly job quota and included features.

authenticated.description: Same tools backed by live data. Connect with OAuth, or send a JobsPipe API key (Authorization: Bearer jp_live_<key>; an x-api-key header also works). Create a key in the dashboard (Settings -> API Keys).
